pictures.name: CJD1-Carpenter-Shop
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A small carpenter’s workshop in first-century Nazareth: rough stone walls, wood shavings on the floor, simple tools hanging, a half-finished wooden door on trestles. In the middle, Joseph, a man of about thirty with a short dark beard and strong calloused hands, in a dusty brown tunic and a leather carpenter’s apron, planes a beam, sleeves rolled up, while through the open doorway Mary, a young woman of about sixteen with dark hair under a soft blue veil, in a simple cream dress, passes by carrying a water jar and they share a shy smile. Warm gold afternoon light, deep blue shadows. Simple goodness, quiet love. No text, no letters, no logos.
